assets.name: OLMo NCP native-window confirmation and mechanism split
assets.question: Can a public-parameter NCP RoPE table improve a frozen mature checkpoint inside its native 4K window, and which tested mechanisms explain that improvement
assets.evidence_grade: Frozen OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct; same-target LM on 128 windows from 103 source documents; output-blind Full-13 x 10 and complete three-task Native Natural-QA census; paired mechanism and final-quarter intervention panels
assets.manuscript_location: Section 6.2 / Appendix E: new NCP diagnostic tasks, same-target NLL and context benefit
assets.interpretation: NCP lowers Native-4K full-context NLL by 0.012786 nat/token, approximately 1.27% PPL, and raises the new Full-13 x 10 fixed-panel score by 3.2564pp. The 99-row Natural-QA census is -0.8549pp. Synthetic counterfactual and fixed final-quarter intervention results exclude those tested panels as a simple mediator but do not erase the formal LM and Full-13 gains.

assets.name: OLMo CA-NCP five-arm coordinate-alignment falsification
assets.question: Does a frozen carrier-aligned rank-2 Q/K coordinate reassignment improve OLMo inside its Native 4K window beyond Native, NCP, and carrier-only controls
assets.evidence_grade: Frozen OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct; exact same output-blind Full-13 x 10 panel across N0/C0/P0/N1/P1; token-exact identity parity; all five raw files contain 130 paired rows and are identified by SHA256 in the formal report
assets.manuscript_location: negative evidence owner; current manuscript unchanged
assets.interpretation: Full-strength alignment is decisively harmful: N1-N0 is -13.13pp and P1-P0 is -11.35pp, with both paired stability intervals wholly negative. P0-C0 is -0.77pp with interval crossing zero. The carrier change neither helps reliably nor repairs alignment, so the original CA-NCP method is not transferred to Llama.

assets.name: OLMo CA-NCP safety-constrained coordinate follow-up
assets.question: Can task-blind operator caps or source-consensus coordinate maps retain the NCP Native-window gain while avoiding the full-strength CA-NCP failure
assets.evidence_grade: Frozen OLMo-2-0425-1B-Instruct; exact same Full-13 x 10 development panel and frozen N0/C0/P0 controls; three candidate raw files contain 130 rows and match the formal report hashes
assets.manuscript_location: negative evidence owner; current manuscript unchanged
assets.interpretation: The safest arm, P_operator_cap, reaches 75.09%, recovering much of the full-strength failure but remaining 1.69pp below C0 and 0.92pp below P0. N_operator_cap is Native-level and P_axis_consensus is worse. The activation-driven coordinate-reassignment route is closed rather than promoted.

assets.name: Kanana official-runtime YaRN comparison at 64K and 128K
assets.question: Can zero-training TailSpline outperform Kanana's documented official runtime YaRN on broad synthetic tasks at 64K and complete-context natural book QA at 128K
assets.evidence_grade: Frozen kakaocorp/kanana-1.5-8b-instruct-2505; paired 64K RULER Full-13 x 10 and paired 128K InfiniteBench English-QA with 118 complete untruncated prompts from 23 source contexts; exact prompt identity and independent scorer replay
assets.manuscript_location: §6.1 / main length and natural-task tables / Appendix D
assets.interpretation: At 64K, TailSpline/MrRoPE-Pro/official runtime YaRN score 72.65/70.33/65.64% on Full-13 x 10. At 128K complete-context English QA, TailSpline scores 19.59% versus official runtime YaRN 17.85%, a +1.74pp fixed-panel lead; cluster-equal scoring also favors TailSpline by +1.58pp. The YaRN contrast is a complete-method runtime comparison, not evidence that the checkpoint was YaRN-trained. The 128K MrRoPE arm was skipped before start.
